tasks.spec:
You are the bounded Codex scoring architect for the corrected Vintage Optical GROW analysis. Write only ./scores.json and ./scoring_notes.md. Do not modify the repository, source data, or evidence pack. Do not fetch or invent new facts. Do not contact anyone, use private data, call MCP/Apps, capture memory, commit, push, send, publish, or deploy.

READ FIRST: /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/vintage-optical-canonical-redo/plan.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/README.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/RUBRIC.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/CALCULATIONS.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/WEBSITE_POSITIONING.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/FIX_IT_PLAYBOOK.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/SCORE_KEYS_AND_SPECIALTY_OPTIONS.md; /mnt/d_drive/repos/optometry-competition-analyzer-rubric/OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md; and all six verified files in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/vintage-optical-canonical-redo/work-evidence/build-canonical-evidence-pack/.

METHOD: manual_directional_banding_public_only. Every base component must be exactly one of 20, 35, 50, 65, or 80. Use 50 for an unknown neutral and set unknown_handling to neutral_unknown_no_directional_claim. Every component needs a parallel basis record with band_label, self-contained rationale, source_ids, confidence, and unknown_handling. Do not use the invalid prior 59/56/72/66 scores or its 0-100 continuous component values as inputs. Compute each composite from the canonical weights and round to nearest whole point. Client Opportunity must use the computed Market Demand-Supply Score at 20 percent plus its five remaining weighted components. Room to Win equals 100 minus the internal Competitive Pressure Index.

REQUIRED STACK: Market Demand-Supply, internal Competitive Pressure, Room to Win, Practice Competitiveness, Client Opportunity, Digital Presence, Confidence Grade C, and at least three Specialty Opportunity lanes. Use only evidence-supported directional bands. Missing polygon demographics, complete supply census, independent review export, capacity, owned conversion, referral proof, and lane economics constrain the score. Preserve uncertainty rather than rewarding public claims as operating proof.

STAGE 2: include website_positioning with Digital Presence components and basis, stated_position, market_position, position_vs_white_space, recommended_position, channel_gaps, evidence, source_ids, and Confidence C. Sampled query visibility is directional, not a rank grid. The 4.9 Maps sample has no review count and cannot support peer-normalized reputation.

STAGE 5: include one GROW fix_it_playbook with no more than three do-now cards. Each card must have id, finding, lever, owner, effort, impact_grow, impact_math, time_to_value, dependency, proof, confidence, source_ids. Use sensitivity or plug-in formulas, not forecasts. Recommended lanes: (1) establish a lane-tagged specialty conversion baseline before adding another service; (2) run a 30-day access diagnostic before changing hours or staffing; (3) clean the stale-address/public-proof loop and establish a review/referral/recall baseline. Phrase as evidence-led actions, not assumptions that leakage exists.

BOUNDARY: schema_version 2.0, analysis_product single_practice, data_mode public_only, report_visibility internal_only_unroomed_draft, Project Room EMPTY/UNROOMED, use_boundary INTERNAL-ONLY / NOT FOR EXTERNAL USE, external_actions_taken none. Include data_quality missing-to-upgrade list, at least four disconfirmers, hidden raw pressure metadata, scoring limitations, and decision residue in scoring_notes.md. No em dash, no client-ready/prospect-ready language, no unsupported dollars, and no secrets.
tasks.verified: the repository's discrete public-only bands, exact score formulas, evidence-linked basis records, Digital Presence module, Specialty Opportunity modules, Confidence C, and maximum-three Fix Cards with shown impact math all validate
